summary: Hierarchical multi-label prediction of Enzyme Commission (EC) numbers from sequence; which reaction class(es) an enzyme catalyzes.
what_it_measures: Each protein is labeled with one or more EC numbers (four-level hierarchy, e.g. 3.1.1.101). The benchmark treats this as multi-label classification over the EC hierarchy (models use per-level heads or flat blocks).
assay_method: Manually curated functional annotation in Swiss-Prot (the reviewed section of UniProtKB), derived from experimental and expert-reviewed evidence.
provenance: Downloaded via the UniProt REST API (`reviewed:true AND ec:*`); EC numbers are split on `;` into multi-labels.
when_to_use: A protein-level functional-classification task probing whether embeddings organize enzymes by catalyzed reaction; a strong signal for many models.
caveats: Label frequencies are highly imbalanced across EC classes: 0.07% of the scored label positions are positive, so predicting no class scores 0.9993 accuracy. AUPRC is the primary metric. Annotation completeness varies.

citations.title: UniProt: the Universal Protein Knowledgebase in 2025
